workarounds.symptom: Gateway bridge hangs after logging "exiting to avoid dual-poll", preventing keepalive restart
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(gateway): bound the lock-lost exit and let the supervisor restart. Target files: packages/ag2-sparrow/ag2_sparrow/__main__.py, packages/ag2-sparrow/ag2_sparrow/remote_gateway_bridge.py, packages/ag2-sparrow/pyproject.toml. **Level:** medium **Reason:** a bridge that loses its poller lock can leave the gateway lane down (13 min in #4179, about 50 min on a desktop install in the #4357 path) until someone kills or restarts it by hand. (Ref: https://github.com/sonichi/sutando/pull/6541)

workarounds.symptom: sync-conflicts-report: malformed cache entries abort the diagnostic
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sync): rescan malformed conflict-report cache entries. Target files: scripts/sync-conflicts-report.py, tests/sync-conflicts-report-incremental.test.py, docs/catalog.json. **Level:** medium **Reason:** A malformed optimization cache can abort the peer-content diagnostic or borrow another copy's retirement key. (Ref: https://github.com/sonichi/sutando/pull/6460)

workarounds.symptom: pr-watch: shutdown returns while state-writing threads are still active
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(pr-watch): drain state writers and child processes before shutdown returns. Target files: skills/pr-watch/scripts/pr_watch.py, tests/skills/pr-watch/pr_watch.test.py, docs/README.md. **Level:** medium **Reason:** an existing shutdown race has failed Python shard 6 in two consecutive CI runs of #6376. (Ref: https://github.com/sonichi/sutando/pull/6380)
